_comment: Where the platforms of these stations really are, against the rule in tools/build_network.py (deep tube lines 'deep', zone 1-2 sub-surface 'sub', the rest 'surface'). Found by comparing each station with the track around it in OpenStreetMap (tools/audit_station_kinds.py) and the platform depth; each setting then checked against Wikipedia and other sources by a research pass (confidence noted where it was only medium). surface = open to the sky (cutting, embankment, viaduct or ground level), sub = covered shallow box, deep = tube tunnels.
